science_limitations.task1: n=3 approximate normality/independence are explicit working assumptions, not proven biological independence. BY does not cure small-n/unknown effective-length assumptions. Untreated2h is absent; early ranges are assumption-dependent sensitivity regions, not confidence intervals or identified effects.
science_limitations.task2: Exact same-library provenance is a technical finite-fixture problem. The three replicates do not become independent experiments. Disjoint gene features share libraries and coexpression; eligibility is frozen before query outcomes but uses all source columns. Held-out certificates are not biological replication, causal evidence, p-values, or out-of-study generalization. Mixture weights are normalized source-representation coefficients, not cell or RNA-mass fractions.
